name: Position Set Dimensions 14
definition: Variables related to derivatives that are used to group derivatives together into positions for position sets.

LoanData.name: Loan Data
LoanData.definition: Details of the loan used for financing the transaction.

CollateralData.name: Collateral Data
CollateralData.definition: Provides the details of the collateral used in the transaction.

OutliersIncluded.name: Outliers Included
OutliersIncluded.definition: Flag to identify whether the reported Securities Financing Transaction position contains abnormal values.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
